title: Catalogue tools and profiles (ship-fleet tools ls --json, version 1)
description: Printed on stdout by `ship-fleet tools ls --json` on the FleetLedger computer: every tool and profile `ship-fleet new --tools/--profile` and `tools add` take, the repo's catalogue (ship/tools/, ship/profiles/) first, then your toolkits' (contracts/toolkit.md), and the toolkits that did not load. Read from the checkout and ships.toml only: it asks no Ship. See contracts/ship-fleet.md.

tools.description: Every tool, in the order `tools ls` prints them: the repo's catalogue by id, then each toolkit's, by id.

kind.description: The recipe's kind (tool-recipe.schema.json): npm, apt, script, claude-plugin, skill-dir, mcp. Show one you do not know as it is.

default.description: The catalogue marks it default: a new Ship gets it unless ships.toml defaults.tools says otherwise (what a new Ship gets is `ship-fleet defaults --json`'s tools). Never true for a toolkit's tool.

needs.description: The sign-ins it needs to work.

profiles.description: Every profile, in the same order as the tools.

broken.description: Toolkits in ships.toml that did not load, by id: their tools and profiles are not listed (`ship-fleet toolkit check ID` says more).

itemId.description: A catalogue id, or toolkit/id for one of your toolkits'.

toolkit.description: The toolkit it comes from; null for the repo's catalogue.

onlyTags.description: Its toolkit's only_tags (ships.toml [toolkit.<id>]): it goes only to Ships with one of these tags, and `new` and `tools add` refuse it elsewhere. null: any Ship (always, for the repo's catalogue).

signinId.description: A sign-in id, as FleetLedger's sign-in registry names it (the built-ins: claude, gcloud, github).
